items.name: Mythily
items.blurb: Top Chef alum Rasika Venkatesa's Tamil restaurant at 129 Havemeyer St, a permanent home for her pop-up. Opened September 30; Wed–Sat 5–10pm, Sun 4–9pm.
items.tags: indian south indian south asian tamil dinner date night restaurant

items.name: Befikre (coming soon)
items.neighborhood: Midtown, near the Empire State Building
items.blurb: The modern Indian bar and kitchen from Canada is staffing up its two-story NYC flagship at 42 W 33rd St, with DJs, live entertainment, and theatrical plating. No opening date yet.
items.tags: indian south asian coming soon cocktails nightlife group friendly dinner

items.name: Matane
items.blurb: A donburi spot at 59 1st Ave whose Matane Don piles minced hamachi, tuna, salmon, crab, and squid over sushi rice, topped with uni and ikura. The name means "see you again."
items.tags: japanese east asian rice bowl donburi sushi seafood casual lunch dinner

items.name: Hommali
items.blurb: A Thai restaurant built around rice (the name means fragrant jasmine rice) from a chef who trained at Eleven Madison Park: dry-aged duck breast, seafood rice, and a tom yum seafood cocktail.
items.tags: thai southeast asian rice duck seafood upscale date night dinner

items.name: Ob Uan
items.blurb: In the former Spice Thai space at 1479 1st Ave, with classics like tom kha, som tum, and several curries and noodle dishes. Open for lunch and dinner every day.
items.tags: thai southeast asian curry noodles casual cheap eats lunch comfort food neighborhood

items.name: Bon Ga
items.blurb: Korean comfort food like bulgogi and seafood pancakes at 408 E 64th St, the former home of Cambodian spot Bayon, with a covered back patio.
items.tags: korean east asian bulgogi comfort food patio outdoor group friendly dinner

items.name: Baan Thai
items.blurb: A casual Thai restaurant with a light-wood dining room and sleek long banquettes.
items.tags: thai southeast asian casual cheap eats group friendly dinner

items.name: Ibérico
items.blurb: A Spanish and Portuguese wine bar from the Colonia Verde couple at 258 DeKalb Ave: pan con tomate, boquerones, and rissóis de leitão (suckling pig pastries). Walk-ins only, open until midnight Mon–Sat.
items.tags: wine tapas spanish portuguese small plates date night late night walk in

items.name: Below Deck
items.blurb: A maritime-themed, reservation-only speakeasy hidden beneath The Bedford's Stone Street location at 55 Stone St.
items.tags: cocktails speakeasy hidden reservation date night intimate nightlife

items.name: June Baby
items.blurb: NYC's first Filipino-American cocktail bar (opened October 28 at 197 Second Ave): ube piña coladas, a caramelized banana and jackfruit daiquiri, and lumpiang Shanghai. Walk-ins only, Tue–Sun 4pm–midnight.
items.tags: cocktails filipino ube tropical late night walk in group friendly nightlife

items.name: Lady Delilah
items.blurb: A 10,000-square-foot Art Deco supper club below 353 W 14th St from LA's h.wood Group, with bistro dinner, cocktails, and live entertainment all in one night. Opened November 3.
items.tags: cocktails supper club live music upscale date night special occasion nightlife

items.name: Puttery
items.blurb: Adults-only mini golf at 446 W 14th St: 24,000 square feet over five levels, with three bars including a rooftop.
items.tags: mini golf games rooftop bar cocktails group friendly fun interactive nightlife

items.name: Rocky's
items.blurb: Part café, part full bar, part arcade, with Pac-Man among the games.
items.tags: arcade games pac-man cafe bar casual group friendly fun

items.name: Wilkie
items.blurb: A neighborhood bar at 820 Franklin Ave (opened October 21) with $7 snaquiris and beer-and-shot combos. Bring your own food for now; Spam musubi and schnitzel sandwiches are coming.
items.tags: cocktails cheap neighborhood casual byo food snaquiri late night

items.name: Sadie's Bakery
items.blurb: Opened November 9 next door to Sadie's restaurant, with fresh breads, pastries, cakes, cookies, and coffee. Opens daily at 7am.
items.tags: bakery coffee pastry cake cookies breakfast sweet tooth

items.name: Cahoots
items.blurb: A coffee shop you can work from by day and a wine bar at night, at 422 E 9th St, with pastries, parfaits, and sandwiches.
items.tags: coffee work from laptop wine pastries sandwiches casual

items.name: La Cabra
items.blurb: The Danish bakery's fourth NYC location and new flagship, right next to the High Line at 515 W 18th St. The cardamom bun is the house favorite.
items.tags: bakery coffee danish pastry cardamom bun sweet tooth high line

items.name: Neighbors Famous Ice Cream
items.blurb: Hani's, one of the city's most popular bakeries, is opening a stand-alone ice cream shop right next door, with soft serve and hard scoops. Slated for late November.
items.tags: ice cream soft serve dessert sweet tooth

items.name: artport: A History of Internet Art
items.blurb: The Whitney marks 25 years of its online net-art gallery with more than 100 commissioned works online and 25+ in the galleries. Through March 28, 2027.
items.tags: museum art exhibition internet digital indoor rainy day

items.name: New York Fashion at PS1, 1980–1984
items.blurb: Original pieces and partial reconstructions of PS1's early fashion installations by Julio, Charles James, Willi Smith, and Betsey Johnson, for the museum's 50th anniversary. Through March 15, 2027.
items.tags: museum fashion art exhibition queens indoor rainy day

items.name: Union Square Holiday Market
items.blurb: Runs through December 24. Open 11am–8pm Sunday–Wednesday, until 9pm Thursday and Friday, and 10am–9pm Saturday.
items.tags: holiday market shopping gifts outdoor food festival weekend

items.name: Winter Village Rink
items.blurb: Skating is free if you bring your own skates (timed reservation required). Open daily from 8am, until midnight through January 3 and until 10pm after; the rink runs through February 28.
items.tags: ice skating free outdoor holiday winter date night cheap

items.name: Holiday Market at MCNY
items.neighborhood: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem
items.blurb: A holiday market with Brooklyn Pop-Up on December 5 and 6, 10am–5:30pm. The museum is also free on Wednesdays until 9pm through December 30.
items.tags: holiday market gifts museum free weekend shopping

items.name: Grand Bazaar Holiday Markets
items.blurb: Saturday holiday markets on December 12 and 19, with a jewelry showcase, a plant pop-up, and holiday gifts.
items.tags: holiday market gifts shopping jewelry plants weekend
